note: PKB PT Century Textile Industry 2021-2023, signed 8 January 2021, in force 8 January 2021 to 7 January 2023 (58-3); adapted element by element from GOLD-PKB-CENTEX (2024-2026). Difference: 24 THR requires three consecutive months of service and completed probation (2024: one month). Not formalised: 20-1, 21, 39 (nominal amounts outside the agreement; inputs), 20-2e (timing of raises: wage input), 26 (deduction list; inputs), 47-2 (full wage, no change), 53-4 and 55 (severance under UU 13/2003, final tax), 56 (souvenir per the joint agreement of 10 September 2005, value not stated), L4 (unit unclear). 25 alpha undefined: alpha = 0 (GT5 putusan 12). 33-3 other rates and 34 restate the regulation. 22-2 cites 'pasal 19' (a wrong cross reference); the overtime base is taken from L1 C. valid_until is open: 4-2 extends the agreement by one year when no party asks to renew it and 4-4 keeps it in force while a new one is negotiated (the 2024-2026 agreement records negotiations from August 2023 to March 2024), so it governs until PKB-CENTEX-2024 replaces it through the employer policy. The employee attributes centex_probation, centex_four_group_three_shift and attendance_permille keep their names (case data of the same company).
